task:
You will hear one short audio clip and nothing else. It is a single sound made by a person: it might be laughter, it might be a sigh or an exhale, it might be an ordinary spoken word, or it might be nothing at all.

Report only what is actually in the clip. Do not guess what would be likely.

Answer in exactly two lines:
SOUND: one of laugh, sigh, breath, word, other, nothing
WORDS: any actual words spoken, or none
